method: Every source the pack cites was resolved: the seventeen fetched for this pack were read at source on 2026-08-15 and their licence taken off the page or the repository as fetched, and the fourteen already in registry/evidence.json were read back from the ledger without re-fetching, so their licence_state is the ledger's own recorded value. Carried expression was checked by reading the whole read surface (PACK.md, CHECKS.md, four guides, two references, one exemplar) and scanning every span that could have come from a source. licence_state takes five values here: verified means the licence line was read off the source page or repository on the access date; stated-unverified means the source reports a licence but the exact statement was not read directly; not-stated means the source publishes a copyright line or nothing and no reuse licence at all; not-read-at-source means the recorded licence rests on the publisher's class rather than on anything read on the page, which this pack's own B1 forbids and which is recorded rather than hidden; ledger-recorded means the value was carried from registry/evidence.json unchanged.

carried_expression.note: No quoted span of five words or more anywhere in the read surface. No PRISMA checklist text, no GRADE domain wording, no Cochrane handbook sentence, no W3C or IETF specification text, no FAIR principle wording and no Wikipedia policy sentence is reproduced. Property names from PROV-O and field names from the Citation File Format appear as identifiers, which are facts rather than expression. Where a figure appears it is cited to its source. Every finding in sources.fragment.json is a functional description written so that a reader who had never seen the source could reach the wording from the description.
